items.statement: Best of the pack: PAT +20.3% to Rs 4,624 cr, revenue +13.9%, record bookings $2.4 bn; FY27 CC guidance 1-4%; Rs 12 interim dividend.
items.quote: HCL Technologies — Q1 FY27 (call 13 Jul 2026) The standout large-cap IT print this quarter — record deal bookings and a 20% profit jump, with AI revenue scaling fast. Numbers. Revenue Rs 34,579 cr (+13.9% YoY); USD $3.65 bn (+3% YoY, +2.6% CC). Net profit Rs 4,624 cr (+20.3% YoY). EBIT margin 16.9% (up 56 bps YoY) even after a 62 bps restructuring hit. Deal engine. items.statement: HCLTech's operating margins improved by 39 basis points sequentially and 56 basis points year-over-year to reach 16.9%.
items.quote: Our operating margins stood at 16.9%, an improvement of 39 basis points QoQ and an increase of 56 basis points YoY.

items.statement: The company's revenue per employee increased by 3.3% year-over-year, marking five consecutive quarters of growth.
items.quote: Our AI strategy shows evident returns as seen in 3.3% YoY increase in revenue per employee, which has gone up every quarter for the last five quarters.

items.statement: HCLTech's total headcount decreased by 3,292 employees compared to the previous quarter.
items.quote: On the people front, we are 223,889 people as of 30th June 2026, a decrease of 3,292 compared to the previous quarter.

items.statement: Discretionary spending cuts by two large US telecom clients negatively impacted the Engineering and R&D services segment.
items.quote: And we did call out that we had some sharp cuts in discretionary spending in two large US telcos, and we did say that it will have an impact in the subsequent quarters and that is what is playing out.

items.statement: HCLTech is maintaining its organic revenue growth guidance of 1% to 4% and operating margin guidance of 17.5% to 18.5% for fiscal year 2027.
items.quote: Looking ahead, we are retaining our guidance of 1% to 4% and margin guidance of 17.5% to 18.5% for FY27.

items.statement: The company has guided for organic revenue growth of 1% to 4% and operating margins of 17.5% to 18.5% for FY27.
items.quote: Looking ahead, we are retaining our guidance of 1% to 4% and margin guidance of 17.5% to 18.5% for FY27.

items.statement: Global demand for datacenters is projected to triple by 2030, with artificial intelligence driving approximately 70% of this growth.
items.quote: Global datacenter demand is set to triple by 2030 with AI driving roughly 70% of that growth, and in India that growth is expected to happen at an even faster pace.

items.statement: Customers are seeking creative methods to lower their overall token consumption costs when implementing AI models.
items.quote: Now, as the token consumption cost we believe, I mean, it really depends on the exact models that you're implementing, and customers are looking at creative ways to reduce their overall token costs.

items.statement: HCLTech plans to make a strategic investment of up to INR 3,500 crores to enter the AI datacenter business.
items.quote: In this regard, we will make a strategic investment of up to INR3,500 crores and with the potential to scale to 50 megawatts of capacity.

items.statement: The company's new datacenter business has the potential to scale up to 50 megawatts of capacity.
items.quote: In this regard, we will make a strategic investment of up to INR3,500 crores and with the potential to scale to 50 megawatts of capacity.

items.statement: HCLTech achieved its highest-ever Q1 bookings with net new TCV of $2.4 billion, excluding a mega deal signed in early July.
items.quote: Our net new TCV booking for the quarter was $2.4 billion, highest ever Q1 bookings. This excludes the recent mega deal that we announced, which was signed in early July and not in Q1.

items.statement: HCLTech maintained a strong balance sheet with gross cash of $2.86 billion and net cash of $2.84 billion at the end of June 2026.
items.quote: Our balance sheet remains strong with gross cash of $2.86 billion and net cash of $2.84 billion as on 30th June, 2026.

items.statement: HCLTech completed the acquisition of Jaspersoft to add a visualization layer to its data management product portfolio.
items.quote: We have completed the acquisition of Jaspersoft. This adds the visualization layer to our data management portfolio.

items.statement: HCLTech made a strategic investment of $150 million in Sarvam, a full-stack sovereign AI company in India.
items.quote: Most notable is a recent strategic investment of $150 million in Sarvam, India's full-stack sovereign AI company.

items.statement: The global datacenter industry is expected to see demand triple by 2030, driven largely by AI.
items.quote: Global datacenter demand is set to triple by 2030 with AI driving roughly 70% of that growth, and in India that growth is expected to happen at an even faster pace.

items.statement: Traditional commoditized services face the risk of further optimization and disruption as AI-enabled automation expands.
items.quote: On the other side, AI-disrupted services, the more traditional commoditized work, continues to be optimized further as AI-enabled automation takes hold.
We are very happy that we've started the year on a good note despite a seasonally weak Q1. And we're also very encouraged by our bookings and also the potential bookings in Q2.
